note: Draft placements and criticality ratings, not measured facts. Zones: 1 any recent laptop; 2 24-32 GB GPU or 32 GB+ unified memory; 3 128 GB unified memory or multi-GPU. Round 2 (31 Oct 2026) applied the completeness and integrity audit against OWASP LLM 2025 / Agentic 2026, NCSC, NIST AI 600-1, ICO guidance and tool docs.

stations.name: What can my computer do?
stations.unlocks: Reading a model's download page and knowing whether it fits, and what kind of job it's worth trying.
stations.proof: Say how much memory your computer has and how much graphics card memory, without looking; then say fits, depends or doesn't for a 2 GB, a 5 GB and a 20 GB file, and name one job your computer does comfortably and one it doesn't.
stations.ifSkipped: Downloads that never load, or crawl; blame falls on the model.
stations.headNote: Your computer decides which jobs you can do, how well and how fast. Two facts: memory, and graphics card memory if any.

stations.name: Language model basics
stations.unlocks: Reading any model card.
stations.proof: You can say what parameters, quantisation, context and licence mean for you.
stations.ifSkipped: Picking by hype; surprises on memory, speed and rights.
stations.headNote: Size, quantisation, context window, licence.

stations.name: Internet and web basics
stations.unlocks: Knowing what a connection, a request and a page are.
stations.proof: Web Jelly missions.
stations.ifSkipped: Cannot tell a network problem from a model problem.
stations.headNote: Your machine talks to others; you can see when it does.

stations.name: Local chat
stations.unlocks: A chat with a model that runs on a machine you own: this laptop, or a box on your own network.
stations.proof: Ask a question; the answer comes from your own machine or a machine on your own network, and you can name which.
stations.ifSkipped: You never see the whole game, so every later station is abstract.
stations.headNote: The model is a file on a machine you own. The chat app only has to find that machine.

stations.name: Is my chat app talking to anyone else?
stations.unlocks: Knowing, not hoping, that your chat app sent your words only to machines you own.
stations.proof: While the model answers, the chat app has exactly one outbound destination, and it is a private or tailnet address of a machine you own. Nothing to the internet.
stations.ifSkipped: A silent failure: the chat app sends a draft somewhere else and nothing beeps.
stations.headNote: Where did the chat app's bytes go? Read its destinations, not the wifi icon. This checks the chat app only, not the server or any tool; those come later.

stations.name: You're accountable
stations.unlocks: Sending AI-written work with your name on it, knowing you've checked it.
stations.proof: Given a draft with planted errors (a wrong date, an invented rule, a wrong sum), find every one against the source papers.
stations.ifSkipped: A confident draft goes out with a mistake in it, under your name, and nothing beeps.
stations.headNote: Every model gets things wrong, local or hosted, big or small. You read it, you check it against the papers, and you sign it.

stations.name: Decide what you trust
stations.unlocks: Choosing, on purpose, which services see your work and which work stays on machines you own.
stations.proof: Name which services you trust with client work, and which work stays on machines you own.
stations.ifSkipped: Client work ends up wherever the nearest app happens to send it.
stations.headNote: You already trust some channels (your email, your network). Local AI is for the work you keep on machines you own.

stations.name: Shell basics
stations.unlocks: Running scripts, reading errors, fixing paths.
stations.proof: Shell Jelly 1 and 2 missions.
stations.ifSkipped: Every script is magic you cannot debug.
stations.headNote: Files, folders, commands, permissions.

stations.name: Tested backups
stations.unlocks: Giving anything write access.
stations.proof: You restored one file from backup this month.
stations.ifSkipped: Agent deletes the folder; nothing comes back.
stations.headNote: Backups you have not restored are a hope, not a backup.

stations.name: Structured JSON
stations.unlocks: Chaining tasks, agent tool calls, extraction.
stations.proof: Model fills a 5-field schema from a sample, 10 of 10 valid.
stations.ifSkipped: Pipelines break on malformed output and you cannot see why.
stations.headNote: Why machines need fixed shapes and models drift from them.

stations.name: Least privilege
stations.unlocks: Any station where the AI acts.
stations.proof: Security Jelly missions 2 and 5.
stations.ifSkipped: AI with your account can reach everything you can.
stations.headNote: Give each worker only the keys it needs.

stations.name: Hardening ledger
stations.unlocks: Toggling controls off and on with a record.
stations.proof: Every config change is a commit with a one-line reason; you can revert one.
stations.ifSkipped: Nobody knows what is on, what is off, or why.
stations.headNote: A change log is the only honest memory of a setup.

stations.name: Git basics
stations.unlocks: Undo for everything the agent touches.
stations.proof: Git Jelly missions; you can revert a commit.
stations.ifSkipped: No undo when the agent breaks something.
stations.headNote: Commits are save points; revert is the undo.

stations.name: Containers and micro-VMs
stations.unlocks: The mechanism behind sandboxing.
stations.proof: Agent runs with no host Docker socket mounted; ports bound to loopback.
stations.ifSkipped: A container that can reach the host through a mounted socket.
stations.headNote: A container is not a sandbox until you check what it can see.

stations.name: Vet extensions
stations.unlocks: Installing MCP servers, custom nodes and plugins without installing malware.
stations.proof: Every extension has source, pinned version and a review note.
stations.ifSkipped: Executable code from a stranger running as you.
stations.headNote: Extensions are programs; model files are data.

stations.name: Secrets out of prompts and repos
stations.unlocks: Tokens and passwords nowhere a model or a repo can see them.
stations.proof: A grep of repos, prompts and config finds no tokens.
stations.ifSkipped: One leaked prompt or commit leaks an account.
stations.headNote: The system prompt is not a secret.

stations.name: Hardware keys and passkeys
stations.unlocks: The root accounts every agent grant derives from, protected.
stations.proof: Email, registrar and vault require a hardware key; recovery codes are in a tested backup.
stations.ifSkipped: Phished once, everything downstream falls.
stations.headNote: Losing the key is the irreversible failure; back up the recovery codes.

stations.name: Minimise and redact before prompting
stations.unlocks: Models, logs and memory see placeholders, not account numbers.
stations.proof: A test record with names and numbers reaches the model as placeholders only.
stations.ifSkipped: Personal data copied into every log, cache and memory.
stations.headNote: Encryption protects storage; minimisation protects what the model sees.

stations.name: Retention and deletion
stations.unlocks: Deleting one person’s data everywhere it was copied.
stations.proof: Delete one person and show it gone from chat history, vector store, memory, traces and backups.
stations.ifSkipped: Copies you forgot about: caches, embeddings, traces.
stations.headNote: Local AI scatters copies; nothing reminds you.

stations.name: Context window
stations.unlocks: Long inputs, agents, RAG.
stations.proof: You can predict when a document will not fit and what happens then.
stations.ifSkipped: It silently forgets the start; you trust half an answer.
stations.headNote: The model only sees what fits; the rest is gone.

stations.name: Prefill vs generation
stations.unlocks: Choosing batch vs interactive; judging hardware.
stations.proof: You can explain why 80 pages took two minutes before the first word.
stations.ifSkipped: Buying the wrong hardware for the job.
stations.headNote: Reading is bandwidth-bound and fast; writing is one token at a time.

stations.name: Download safely
stations.unlocks: Any new model.
stations.proof: Known publisher; safetensors or GGUF, not pickle; checksum matches.
stations.ifSkipped: A model file is a program; a bad one runs on your machine.
stations.headNote: A model file is untrusted input, exactly like an email attachment.

stations.name: Run it
stations.unlocks: Using a model outside the chat app.
stations.proof: Model served on a local port; a one-line request returns an answer.
stations.ifSkipped: Stuck in one app forever.
stations.headNote: Press go while the server is bound to loopback. Opened to the network it is an unauthenticated API.

stations.name: System one models
stations.unlocks: Ultra-efficient fast classifiers: models that return only structured results (a label, a score, fields, a vector), never free text. Also routers, extractors, embedders, rerankers.
stations.proof: A system one classifier labels 20 items in under a second with 18 or more right, and cannot be prompted into writing prose.
stations.ifSkipped: Paying a general model, and taking on its injection risk, for every reflex step.
stations.headNote: System one answers by reflex with structure only; system two reasons in text. Most steps in a pipeline or agent are system one jobs. Jev (hosted) started the category; open ones you can run yourself include Kev (0.8B to 27B, Qwen base, Apache-2.0), Von and Laya (encoder models, CPU), and SemIf (reads option probabilities from a model you already run).

stations.name: Test on your own examples
stations.unlocks: Trusting a model for your job.
stations.proof: 5 to 10 real cases with known answers, scored.
stations.ifSkipped: Benchmark numbers that do not match your documents.
stations.headNote: A benchmark is somebody else’s job; yours is the only one that counts.

stations.name: Compare and choose
stations.unlocks: Switching when a new model lands.
stations.proof: Two candidates on the same set, results written down.
stations.ifSkipped: Churn with every release, no basis to decide.
stations.headNote: Same set, same scoring, write it down.

stations.name: Evaluation harness
stations.unlocks: Automated, repeatable scoring of a model on your own cases.
stations.proof: One command scores a model on 50 cases and prints a number you trust.
stations.ifSkipped: Changing models or prompts on vibes.
stations.headNote: A score you can rerun is the only way to know a change helped.

stations.name: Data synthesis
stations.unlocks: Generating training and evaluation examples with a model.
stations.proof: 200 synthetic cases, a sample of 20 checked by hand, under 2 bad.
stations.ifSkipped: Training on nonsense; personal data or licensed text leaking into a dataset.
stations.headNote: Synthetic data inherits the biases and the rights of what it was made from.

stations.name: Fine-tunes, adapters and LoRAs
stations.unlocks: Teaching a model your format, style, character or domain.
stations.proof: Fine-tuned model beats the base on your harness; a LoRA reproduces your character or style.
stations.ifSkipped: A worse model that feels better; wasted GPU hours.
stations.headNote: Adapters are small and swappable; full fine-tunes are not. Evaluate before and after.

stations.name: Quantisation: format and level
stations.unlocks: Fitting a bigger model into your memory by trading quality.
stations.proof: Same model at Q4 and Q8 on your 20 test prompts; you can state memory saved and quality lost.
stations.ifSkipped: Quietly worse answers that you blame on the model.
stations.headNote: Fit versus quality is a dial you can measure.

stations.name: KV cache and prompt caching
stations.unlocks: Fast repeated prompts; knowing what the cache holds.
stations.proof: A repeated long system prompt shows near-zero prefill on the second call.
stations.ifSkipped: Paying prefill every time; cache files on disk you did not know about.
stations.headNote: The cache is memory and it is data; both need a budget.

stations.name: Guided (constrained) decoding
stations.unlocks: Output that always parses.
stations.proof: Server enforces a JSON schema; 100 of 100 outputs parse.
stations.ifSkipped: Pipelines that break on the one malformed output.
stations.headNote: Valid is not the same as correct.

stations.name: Parallel serving and batching
stations.unlocks: Several requests or people on one box.
stations.proof: Four simultaneous requests finish faster than four sequential ones.
stations.ifSkipped: A household or team fighting over one GPU.
stations.headNote: Throughput and per-request context trade off.

stations.name: Inference optimisation
stations.unlocks: The same model, faster: offload split, KV-cache quantisation, speculative decoding, batch and thread settings.
stations.proof: Tokens per second measured before and after each change; identical output at temperature 0.
stations.ifSkipped: Slow serving you blame on the hardware.
stations.headNote: Four levers, each a trade-off: speed for memory, context for a small quality risk, memory for faster generation. Change one, measure, keep or revert.

stations.name: Model routing and fallback
stations.unlocks: Easy requests to a small model, hard ones to a big one.
stations.proof: Eval numbers show the large model adds nothing on the easy set.
stations.ifSkipped: Paying a large model for every trivial step, or routing hard work to a weak model.
stations.headNote: Routing by difficulty needs evidence to be safe.

stations.name: Model licences
stations.unlocks: Knowing what you may do with a model.
stations.proof: For every model in use: licence name, commercial use yes or no, field-of-use limits.
stations.ifSkipped: A breach is silent and the bill comes later.
stations.headNote: Open weights is not open source.

stations.name: Training-data provenance
stations.unlocks: Knowing where every fine-tuning row came from.
stations.proof: Every row records source, licence and generator model.
stations.ifSkipped: Licence and personal-data problems baked into weights, invisible.
stations.headNote: Once trained in, it cannot be removed.

stations.name: Split one model across machines
stations.unlocks: Models larger than any one box.
stations.proof: A model too big for one machine serves from two; you can name the bottleneck.
stations.ifSkipped: Version skew and link speed surprises.
stations.headNote: The network is now part of the model.

stations.name: Summarise
stations.unlocks: Gist of anything under about 6k tokens.
stations.proof: A summary of a document you know well misses nothing important.
stations.ifSkipped: Faithful-sounding summaries that drop the clause that mattered.
stations.headNote: Press go, then read it against the original once.

stations.name: Classify and route
stations.unlocks: Sorting, tagging, triage; the first step of most agents.
stations.proof: 20 hand-labelled items; model agrees on 18 or more.
stations.ifSkipped: Silent mis-sorting at scale.
stations.headNote: A general model can do it; a small specialist model does it faster and cheaper.

stations.name: Extract to JSON
stations.unlocks: Pulling dates, names, amounts into fields.
stations.proof: Fields match 10 hand-filled forms.
stations.ifSkipped: Wrong field values that look right.
stations.headNote: Check fields, not prose.

stations.name: Translate
stations.unlocks: Sentence to page.
stations.proof: A passage you can read in both languages.
stations.ifSkipped: Fluent nonsense.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Write and edit
stations.unlocks: Drafting, rewriting, proofreading in private.
stations.proof: Your own voice survives a rewrite.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious; the quality bar is yours.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Review queue (human in the loop)
stations.unlocks: Low-confidence outputs routed to a person.
stations.proof: Low-confidence extractions queue for review; you sample 5% of auto-accepted ones.
stations.ifSkipped: Bad data accepted at scale.
stations.headNote: Data quality, distinct from approving agent actions.

stations.name: Analyse tabular exports
stations.unlocks: Questions over spreadsheets and bank exports answered by code.
stations.proof: Answers about a CSV are computed by code you can read, not by the model’s arithmetic.
stations.ifSkipped: Confident wrong sums.
stations.headNote: The model writes the code; a sandbox runs it.

stations.name: PDF text layer
stations.unlocks: Text from born-digital PDFs, no AI needed.
stations.proof: Page count in equals page count out; spot-check three pages.
stations.ifSkipped: Garbled text fed to every later station.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Scan OCR
stations.unlocks: Text from scanned pages.
stations.proof: Your worst scan, checked line by line.
stations.ifSkipped: Dropped lines you never notice.
stations.headNote: Scans are pictures; a model is guessing the letters.

stations.name: Tables and layout
stations.unlocks: Multi-column pages, tables kept as tables.
stations.proof: A re-extracted table matches the original cell for cell.
stations.ifSkipped: Numbers shift columns.
stations.headNote: Layout is information; flattening loses it.

stations.name: Embeddings and chunking
stations.unlocks: Search over your own documents.
stations.proof: Search finds the document you know is right.
stations.ifSkipped: It retrieves the wrong page confidently.
stations.headNote: Search by meaning, in pieces; piece size changes what is found.

stations.name: Ask your own docs
stations.unlocks: Questions across a folder, with citations.
stations.proof: Answer cites the page; the page says what the answer says.
stations.ifSkipped: Hallucinated citations.
stations.headNote: Retrieval first, answer second; check the page.

stations.name: Long document
stations.unlocks: 32k to 128k tokens in one shot.
stations.proof: 100-page document, question answered from page 90.
stations.ifSkipped: Two-minute waits with no explanation, or truncated input.
stations.headNote: Fit and wait time, before you start.

stations.name: Encrypt at rest
stations.unlocks: Personal documents on the box.
stations.proof: Encryption on; you have unlocked after a reboot.
stations.ifSkipped: Laptop stolen, bundle exposed.
stations.headNote: What is encrypted, what unlocks it, and that unlock survives a reboot.

stations.name: Hybrid search and reranking
stations.unlocks: Finding the right passage more often.
stations.proof: Keyword plus vector plus reranker beats vector-only on 20 of your own questions.
stations.ifSkipped: Quiet retrieval misses that look like model failures.
stations.headNote: Most RAG failures are retrieval failures.

stations.name: Grounding check and RAG evaluation
stations.unlocks: Answers you can trust in legal or medical use.
stations.proof: Every answer cites a passage; hit rate and faithfulness measured on a gold set.
stations.ifSkipped: A wrong answer with a confident citation.
stations.headNote: A citation is not a check until you read the passage.

stations.name: Vision: describe an image
stations.unlocks: Captions, screenshots to text.
stations.proof: Describes a photo you took, including small text.
stations.ifSkipped: Wrong reading of a chart or screen.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Speech to text
stations.unlocks: Transcripts from recordings.
stations.proof: A 2-minute clip you transcribed yourself, under 5 errors.
stations.ifSkipped: Minutes built on misheard names and numbers.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Speaker labels and word timing
stations.unlocks: Who said what, when; subtitles; lyric timing.
stations.proof: Two-person clip, speakers right, timestamps within a second.
stations.ifSkipped: Actions assigned to the wrong person.
stations.headNote: Timing and diarisation are separate steps that can each fail.

stations.name: Classical computer vision (OpenCV)
stations.unlocks: Crop, deskew, threshold, detect motion, extract frames, no model needed.
stations.proof: A skewed scan straightened and cleaned by a script.
stations.ifSkipped: Feeding a model garbage it then guesses at.
stations.headNote: Many vision jobs are arithmetic, not intelligence; do those first.

stations.name: Audio separation
stations.unlocks: Vocals and instruments apart.
stations.proof: A song splits into vocal and backing tracks.
stations.ifSkipped: Later stages get muddy input.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Video in
stations.unlocks: Clip to description or Q&A.
stations.proof: Describes a 30-second clip in order.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious for home use.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Streaming speech: VAD, real-time STT, wake word
stations.unlocks: A microphone that listens and responds live.
stations.proof: Wake word fires locally; partial transcript within a second; silence yields nothing.
stations.ifSkipped: An always-on microphone you did not think about.
stations.headNote: Latency and an always-on mic are the new failures.

stations.name: Object detection
stations.unlocks: People, cars and objects located in frames.
stations.proof: People and cars detected in 100 frames at a threshold you chose.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Text to speech
stations.unlocks: Documents read aloud, podcast voices.
stations.proof: A paragraph you wrote, listened to end to end.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Make an image
stations.unlocks: A picture from a prompt.
stations.proof: An image saved to your folder from your prompt.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Seeds and sampling
stations.unlocks: Getting the same image back; controlled variation.
stations.proof: Same prompt and seed twice gives the same image.
stations.ifSkipped: You can never reproduce the one you liked.
stations.headNote: Randomness has a dial.

stations.name: Edit an image
stations.unlocks: Change one thing, keep the rest.
stations.proof: “Make the sky darker” changes only the sky.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Character consistency
stations.unlocks: Same person or style across many images.
stations.proof: Five images, the character recognisably the same.
stations.ifSkipped: Pipelines produce a different hero every shot.
stations.headNote: A style sheet is state the pipeline must carry.

stations.name: Node-graph pipelines (ComfyUI)
stations.unlocks: Chaining image, video and audio models visually, and driving the graph from a script.
stations.proof: A saved graph runs from the API and writes to your folder.
stations.ifSkipped: Hand-running every stage of every pipeline.
stations.headNote: A graph is a pipeline you can see; the API makes it a pipeline you can script.

stations.name: Music generation
stations.unlocks: A song from lyrics and a style prompt.
stations.proof: A 2-minute track you would play to someone.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Video generation
stations.unlocks: Clips from a prompt or a still.
stations.proof: A 5-second clip from one of your images.
stations.ifSkipped: Time and electricity.
stations.headNote: Press go, then wait.

stations.name: Lip-sync and audio-driven video
stations.unlocks: A face singing or speaking to a track.
stations.proof: Mouth matches a sung line you can hear.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Clean vocals in, timing in, face out.

stations.name: Stitch and mix
stations.unlocks: Clips and sound into one file.
stations.proof: Clips join without gaps; audio in sync.
stations.ifSkipped: Pipeline output nobody can watch.
stations.headNote: Press go (ffmpeg).

stations.name: Likeness and consent
stations.unlocks: Cloning or reanimating a real voice or face lawfully.
stations.proof: A consent record exists for every real voice or face used.
stations.ifSkipped: Irreversible harm to a real person.
stations.headNote: Spans voice cloning, lip-sync and face swap.

stations.name: Voice cloning
stations.unlocks: A voice from a short sample.
stations.proof: Your own voice cloned and outputs labelled synthetic.
stations.ifSkipped: Impersonation.
stations.headNote: Same tech as TTS, different harm.

stations.name: Guided image generation (ControlNet, pose, depth)
stations.unlocks: Composition and pose under your control.
stations.proof: Same pose from a reference skeleton three times.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: The main lever for consistency.

stations.name: Upscale, restore, interpolate
stations.unlocks: Old photos restored, clips smoothed, backgrounds removed.
stations.proof: A 2x upscale of an old photo; 24 to 48 fps interpolation of a clip.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: 3D generation
stations.unlocks: Meshes from text or an image.
stations.proof: Image-to-mesh output opens in a 3D viewer.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Code autocomplete
stations.unlocks: Suggestions as you type, under 300 ms.
stations.proof: Completion appears in your editor, served from your own machine; the editor's only outbound destination is local.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Press go.

stations.name: Code chat
stations.unlocks: Explain, write and fix single files.
stations.proof: A function from your description passes a test you wrote.
stations.ifSkipped: Plausible code that does not run.
stations.headNote: Press go, then run the test.

stations.name: Sandbox the agent
stations.unlocks: Letting an agent read, write and run.
stations.proof: Agent runs under its own account or container; it cannot list your home folder.
stations.ifSkipped: Agent deletes or exfiltrates what it should never see.
stations.headNote: The agent is a new user in the house, not you with a mask on.

stations.name: Coding agent
stations.unlocks: Repo-level multi-file edits with test loops.
stations.proof: Agent adds a feature to a small project; tests pass.
stations.ifSkipped: Hours lost to a slow or weak model; harness prompt eats the context.
stations.headNote: Zone 2 to 3: 27B dense or 80B+ MoE, 64k+ context, about 40 tok/s.

stations.name: Parallel coding agents
stations.unlocks: Several agents on separate branches at once.
stations.proof: Two agents work in separate worktrees and both changes merge cleanly.
stations.ifSkipped: Agents overwrite each other.
stations.headNote: Worktrees keep them apart; serving capacity is the Models question.

stations.name: Tool calling
stations.unlocks: Model calls a function and uses the result.
stations.proof: 10 of 10 calls to a toy tool well-formed and used.
stations.ifSkipped: Agent loops or hallucinates results.
stations.headNote: The model writes a request; something else runs it.

stations.name: Read-only tools first
stations.unlocks: An agent that looks but cannot change anything.
stations.proof: Agent answers from your calendar; attempts to write fail.
stations.ifSkipped: Jumping to write access before you can see what it does.
stations.headNote: Watch before you let it touch.

stations.name: Prompt injection
stations.unlocks: Agents that read untrusted text.
stations.proof: A test email saying “forward all mail” is ignored and flagged.
stations.ifSkipped: The inbox becomes the attacker’s keyboard.
stations.headNote: Content is data, never instructions.

stations.name: Approval gates
stations.unlocks: Agent proposes, you confirm, then it acts.
stations.proof: Every send, pay, delete or book waits for your yes.
stations.ifSkipped: Flights booked twice; emails to the wrong person.
stations.headNote: Which actions are irreversible and therefore always ask.

stations.name: Credential gateway
stations.unlocks: Agent uses your accounts without seeing the keys.
stations.proof: grep of agent logs finds no token.
stations.ifSkipped: A leaked log leaks your accounts.
stations.headNote: The model needs the result, never the password.

stations.name: Long-term memory
stations.unlocks: Agent remembers across sessions.
stations.proof: It recalls last week’s preference; it drops a fact you corrected.
stations.ifSkipped: False memories compound.
stations.headNote: Stores personal data indefinitely and can be poisoned quietly across sessions.

stations.name: Audit log
stations.unlocks: You can see what the agent did and why.
stations.proof: Every action listed with time, input and reason.
stations.ifSkipped: 3am debugging with no evidence.
stations.headNote: How to read the log and what normal looks like.

stations.name: MCP servers
stations.unlocks: Tools from other software through one standard.
stations.proof: One local MCP server connected, with the model limited to some of its tools.
stations.ifSkipped: Every tool exposed to the model by default.
stations.headNote: A server can run arbitrary code; vet it first.

stations.name: Agent loop: plan, act, observe, stop
stations.unlocks: A model that completes a multi-step task.
stations.proof: Agent finishes a five-step task and stops at an iteration cap you set.
stations.ifSkipped: Loops, drift, never stopping.
stations.headNote: Stopping is a design decision.

stations.name: Workflow engines
stations.unlocks: A fixed graph with LLM steps instead of a free agent.
stations.proof: The same task built as a fixed graph; you can say which is safer.
stations.ifSkipped: Using an agent where a script would do.
stations.headNote: Fixed graphs are usually the safer choice.

stations.name: Unattended and scheduled agents
stations.unlocks: Jobs that run while nobody watches.
stations.proof: Nightly job runs, emits a summary, halts on budget breach with nobody watching.
stations.ifSkipped: Failures nobody sees until the damage is done.
stations.headNote: No human watching means every failure is quiet.

stations.name: Browser and computer-use agents
stations.unlocks: Agents that drive a browser or desktop.
stations.proof: Agent fills a form in a sandboxed browser and stops at Submit for approval.
stations.ifSkipped: Every web page becomes an instruction channel with full UI reach.
stations.headNote: Pages are untrusted input.

stations.name: Multi-agent orchestration
stations.unlocks: Agents handing work to each other.
stations.proof: Two agents hand off a task with every message logged and attributed.
stations.ifSkipped: Cascading failures nobody can trace.
stations.headNote: Agents trust each other too easily.

stations.name: Separate agent identity
stations.unlocks: The agent acts as itself, never as you.
stations.proof: Agent’s actions appear under its own account.
stations.ifSkipped: Actions you cannot tell apart from your own.
stations.headNote: A new user in the house, not you in a mask.

stations.name: Scoped access
stations.unlocks: Each grant limited to what the task needs.
stations.proof: A read-only mail token cannot send; tested by trying.
stations.ifSkipped: An agent with your whole inbox and calendar.
stations.headNote: Scope belongs to each grant, not to the sandbox.

stations.name: Treat model output as untrusted
stations.unlocks: Generated code and HTML never run raw.
stations.proof: Output containing a shell command or script tag is never executed or rendered.
stations.ifSkipped: Injection in, execution out.
stations.headNote: Injection is the entrance; output handling is the exit.

stations.name: Budgets: loops, rate, tokens, spend
stations.unlocks: Runaway agents stop by themselves.
stations.proof: A runaway loop halts at its cap and alerts; outbound emails capped per hour.
stations.ifSkipped: A cooked GPU, a full disk or 500 sent emails.
stations.headNote: Caps on everything that can run away.

stations.name: Memory hygiene
stations.unlocks: Memories you can review, revert and wipe.
stations.proof: Every memory entry has a source; a wipe is tested.
stations.ifSkipped: Poisoned memories that persist across sessions.
stations.headNote: What it remembers, it will act on.

stations.name: Kill switch
stations.unlocks: Stopping the agent and revoking its access in one action.
stations.proof: One action stops the agent and revokes its tokens; drilled quarterly.
stations.ifSkipped: An agent you cannot stop at 3am.
stations.headNote: Recording and stopping fail differently.

stations.name: Red-team your own agent
stations.unlocks: A fixed attack suite rerun on every change.
stations.proof: Injection and jailbreak cases rerun on each model or prompt change.
stations.ifSkipped: Knowing the threat but never testing for it.
stations.headNote: Knowing is not testing.

stations.name: Bind and firewall the AI box
stations.unlocks: A model server only you can reach.
stations.proof: From another device the model port refuses; from the internet nothing answers.
stations.ifSkipped: Someone else using your GPU, silently.
stations.headNote: Most local servers ship with no authentication.

stations.name: Private remote access (VPN or tailnet)
stations.unlocks: Reaching your box from outside without opening it to everyone.
stations.proof: Your UI loads on a phone on 4G while the public port stays closed.
stations.ifSkipped: Opening a public port because you wanted remote access.
stations.headNote: Private access and public exposure are different tools. Tailscale and similar give every machine you own a private address that works from anywhere, without opening a port.

stations.name: Network segmentation
stations.unlocks: Limiting what a compromised box can reach.
stations.proof: AI box on its own segment; laptop reaches box, box cannot reach laptop.
stations.ifSkipped: A compromised agent box with the whole home network in reach.
stations.headNote: Blast radius.

stations.name: Outbound allowlist
stations.unlocks: Agents that may reach some sites and nothing else.
stations.proof: A canary request to an unlisted domain is blocked and logged.
stations.ifSkipped: Data leaving through any channel the agent finds.
stations.headNote: Offline is all or nothing; agents need the graded version.

stations.name: Pin and reproduce
stations.unlocks: Rebuilding last month’s output exactly.
stations.proof: Rebuild an output from a manifest of model hash, quant, server version, parameters and seed.
stations.ifSkipped: Results you cannot reproduce or explain.
stations.headNote: A manifest per run.

stations.name: Tracing and observability
stations.unlocks: Answering why it was slow or wrong.
stations.proof: Every request has a span with model, tokens, latency and tool calls.
stations.ifSkipped: Debugging by guesswork.
stations.headNote: Traces contain prompts, so they are data too.

stations.name: Logs you actually read
stations.unlocks: Noticing scans and failures.
stations.proof: Weekly review of server and tunnel logs; you can spot a scan.
stations.ifSkipped: Attacks and errors nobody saw.
stations.headNote: A log nobody reads is not a control.

stations.name: Power, heat and running cost
stations.unlocks: Knowing what the box costs to run and when it throttles.
stations.proof: Watts at idle and under load, pounds per day, throttle temperature.
stations.ifSkipped: A slow box and a surprising electricity bill.
stations.headNote: Local AI is paid for in electricity.

stations.name: DPIA for business use
stations.unlocks: Using personal data in a business lawfully.
stations.proof: A written assessment for each business destination that touches personal data.
stations.ifSkipped: Processing personal data with no record of why it is acceptable.
stations.headNote: The ICO’s preferred way to show compliance.

stations.name: Static site
stations.unlocks: A site with no server-side code to attack.
stations.proof: Site builds to a folder of files; opens locally.
stations.ifSkipped: A database you must now defend.
stations.headNote: No server code means almost nothing to break into.

stations.name: Tunnel, gated
stations.unlocks: Site reachable from outside, behind a login.
stations.proof: Friend with the login sees it; you without it do not.
stations.ifSkipped: Open door by default.
stations.headNote: The tunnel is the one door in the castle wall.

stations.name: Tunnel toggle
stations.unlocks: Door open only when you want.
stations.proof: Off: external check fails. On: it works. Both in the ledger.
stations.ifSkipped: Forgetting it is on.
stations.headNote: Default off, with an auto-expiry. A toggle left on is quiet exposure.

stations.name: Tunnel, public
stations.unlocks: Anyone can reach it.
stations.proof: Access log shows hits; you know which are bots.
stations.ifSkipped: Hackers knocking with no record.
stations.headNote: Public means bots within minutes; read the log.

stations.name: Private legal drafting
stations.unlocks: Confidential drafts that only ever reach a machine you own.
stations.proof: A draft written and read before it's signed; the chat app's only destination is a machine you own, on your own network.
stations.ifSkipped: A cloud fallback leaks the brief.
stations.headNote: The chat app talks only to your machines, and you answer for every word you sign.

stations.name: Personal finance over bank exports
stations.unlocks: Questions over your own statements, answered by code.
stations.proof: Monthly totals match your bank’s own figures.
stations.ifSkipped: Wrong sums; statements leaking.
stations.headNote: Offline proof and encryption.

stations.name: Newsletter and blog pipeline
stations.unlocks: Research to published post.
stations.proof: A post with checked citations published to your static site.
stations.ifSkipped: Fabricated claims published under your name.
stations.headNote: Grounding and licence.

stations.name: Legal bundle review
stations.unlocks: Chronology, parties and dates from a bundle, with citations.
stations.proof: A bundle you know, every citation checked against the page.
stations.ifSkipped: Confident wrong citations; bundle exposed if stolen.
stations.headNote: Scripted, 5 to 6 steps; offline proof and encryption are red.

stations.name: Research assistant with citations
stations.unlocks: Questions answered from sources you can check.
stations.proof: Every claim cites a passage that says what the claim says.
stations.ifSkipped: Confident fabrication with fake citations.
stations.headNote: Grounding, injection, egress, outputs.

stations.name: Accessibility reader
stations.unlocks: Any document read aloud or described.
stations.proof: A scanned letter read aloud correctly, tables included.
stations.ifSkipped: Quiet OCR errors read out as fact.
stations.headNote: Recognise quiet OCR errors.

stations.name: Customer support bot over company docs
stations.unlocks: Answers for customers from your own documents.
stations.proof: Twenty real questions answered with citations; a hostile question refused.
stations.ifSkipped: Wrong answers to customers; personal data retained without basis.
stations.headNote: Eight red stations; this is a business.

stations.name: Invoice and receipt processing
stations.unlocks: Receipts to structured records.
stations.proof: Fifty receipts; totals match a hand count.
stations.ifSkipped: Wrong figures accepted; financial records exposed.
stations.headNote: Encryption, backups, retention.

stations.name: Knowledge base for a small team
stations.unlocks: Shared search over team documents, private to the team.
stations.proof: A user cannot retrieve a document they are not allowed to open.
stations.ifSkipped: Cross-user leakage through a shared index.
stations.headNote: Identity, encryption, backups, retention, DPIA, grounding.

stations.name: Meeting minutes
stations.unlocks: Recording to minutes with action items.
stations.proof: A real meeting, minutes checked by an attendee.
stations.ifSkipped: Actions assigned to the wrong person.
stations.headNote: Scripted, 4 steps.

stations.name: Searchable photo archive
stations.unlocks: Find your own photos by description.
stations.proof: “Red bike” finds the photo you had in mind.
stations.ifSkipped: Private photos readable if the box is stolen.
stations.headNote: Scripted, 3 steps.

stations.name: Voice assistant
stations.unlocks: Wake word to speech to model to speech, all local.
stations.proof: Ask it the time with the router's internet cable out; it answers within two seconds.
stations.ifSkipped: An always-on mic that sends audio somewhere.
stations.headNote: prove, budgets, download are red.

stations.name: Family photo and video organiser
stations.unlocks: Find any photo or clip by description.
stations.proof: “Beach, 2019, the dog” finds the clip.
stations.ifSkipped: Family data leaking or unrecoverable.
stations.headNote: Encryption, backups, retention, offline proof; consent if faces are named.

stations.name: Language tutor
stations.unlocks: Conversation practice that remembers your mistakes.
stations.proof: It corrects an error you made last week.
stations.ifSkipped: False memories about your progress.
stations.headNote: Memory and its hygiene.

stations.name: CCTV event detection
stations.unlocks: Alerts for people and vehicles, kept local.
stations.proof: A person at the gate triggers an alert; a cat does not; footage expires on schedule.
stations.ifSkipped: Cameras reachable from the internet; footage kept forever.
stations.headNote: Bind, encrypt, retention, DPIA; consent if faces are recognised.

stations.name: Podcast transcription and show notes
stations.unlocks: Transcript, chapters and notes from an episode.
stations.proof: Chapter timestamps land within five seconds.
stations.ifSkipped: Misattributed quotes.
stations.headNote: Backups.

stations.name: Document to podcast
stations.unlocks: A two-voice audio version of a document.
stations.proof: Listen end to end; nothing misread.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Scripted, 4 steps.

stations.name: Illustrated story book
stations.unlocks: A story with a consistent hero on every page.
stations.proof: Ten pages, same character, you approved each.
stations.ifSkipped: Different hero every page.
stations.headNote: Human in the loop, 5 steps.

stations.name: Video dubbing
stations.unlocks: A clip speaking another language.
stations.proof: Native speaker understands it; mouth roughly matches.
stations.ifSkipped: Nothing serious.
stations.headNote: Scripted, 4 steps.

stations.name: Prompt to music video
stations.unlocks: A finished music video from one prompt.
stations.proof: Three minutes you would show someone.
stations.ifSkipped: Most maintenance on the map.
stations.headNote: Stateful pipeline, 8 steps, several models.

stations.name: Code review bot
stations.unlocks: Review comments on every change.
stations.proof: Bot flags a planted bug and never runs the code it reviews outside the sandbox.
stations.ifSkipped: Secrets in diffs reaching logs; injected code comments.
stations.headNote: Sandbox, injection, outputs, secrets.

stations.name: Personal agent
stations.unlocks: “Find me flights”, inbox triage, calendar changes.
stations.proof: A week read-only, then one approved write a day, log reviewed.
stations.ifSkipped: Everything in the security section.
stations.headNote: Every control on this line is red.

stations.name: Home automation agent
stations.unlocks: Lights, heating and devices by voice or schedule.
stations.proof: Agent controls only the devices you exposed; a request for an unexposed one is refused.
stations.ifSkipped: An agent with the whole house.
stations.headNote: Expose few devices; approvals for anything that unlocks or heats.

stations.name: Email triage
stations.unlocks: Inbox sorted and summarised, nothing sent.
stations.proof: A week of correct sorting; a hostile test email ignored and flagged.
stations.ifSkipped: Mis-sorting, or an injected email acting on your behalf.
stations.headNote: Read-only first; seven red stations.

stations.name: Meeting to tasks
stations.unlocks: Minutes that become tasks in your task tool.
stations.proof: Tasks created with the right owners after your approval.
stations.ifSkipped: Tasks assigned to the wrong person, automatically.
stations.headNote: Scopes and approvals.

stations.name: Website live
stations.unlocks: Your own site, built by an agent, reachable by anyone.
stations.proof: Friend opens it from their phone; access log shows the hit.
stations.ifSkipped: Open door, no record.
stations.headNote: Sandbox and both tunnel stations are red.
